mapper.sql: SELECT o.id, o.user_id, o.name, o.gender, o.phone, o.id_card, o.room_id, o.family_count, o.move_in_date, o.remark, o.create_time, r.room_no AS roomNo, b.name AS buildingName, b.building_no AS buildingNo, u.username AS username FROM t_owner o LEFT JOIN t_room r ON r.id = o.room_id AND r.owner_id = o.id LEFT JOIN t_building b ON b.id = r.building_id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id = o.user_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_fee_bill WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_repair WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_complaint WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_owner SET user_id = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE t_owner SET name = #{name} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_owner (user_id, name, gender, phone, id_card, room_id, family_count, move_in_date, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{idCard}, #{roomId}, #{familyCount}, #{moveInDate}, #{remark}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_owner SET user_id = #{userId}, name = #{name}, gender = #{gender}, phone = #{phone}, id_card = #{idCard}, room_id = #{roomId}, family_count = #{familyCount}, move_in_date = #{moveInDate}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id}
